limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses cancer cell lines; relevance to normal tissues is not established.
The role of p62 in reducing CHMP7 levels is suggested to be through ESCRT-III–related functions, but direct evidence is limited.
The irreversibility of micronuclear collapse is proposed but not fully demonstrated.
Hypoxia experiments were performed at 1% O2, which may not reflect all tumor microenvironments.

methods.name: Micronuclear integrity assay
methods.protocol_description: Micronuclear integrity was assessed using multiple orthogonal approaches. The presence of lamin B1, lamin A, acetylated histone H3 at lysine 9 (H3K9Ac), or red fluorescent protein (RFP) fused to a nuclear localization sequence (NLS) denoted intact micronuclei. Conversely, their absence, or the presence of cGAS, which is rapidly recruited after loss of micronuclear membrane integrity, indicated ruptured micronuclei.
